fundamentals.name: Duolingo, Inc.
fundamentals.summary: Duolingo, Inc. operates as a mobile learning platform in the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company offers 250 language courses, including Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, and Chinese through its Duolingo app. It also provides a digital English language proficiency assessment exam. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

article.headline: Duolingo, Inc. Breaks Out Past 167.48 Buy Point
body: Duolingo, Inc. (DUOL) closed at 171.40, up 3.7% on the day, trading 1.2x its 50-day average volume.

The chart shows a 10-week cup with a 25% correction from the 2026-09-03 high. The buy point is 167.48, ten cents above that high, and the buy range runs to 175.85. Shares cleared the buy point on 2026-11-16, with 0.8x average volume that session, and now sit +2.3% from it.
Latest quarter (2026-09-30): EPS 0.54, -91% year over year; revenue $309.0M, +14%.
Relative strength ranks 92 of 99 within the desk's list. The stock trades +17.0% from its 50-day line and -19.7% from its 52-week high.
Measured against its own daily range, DUOL sits 1.0 ATRs from the 21-day exponential average: the session's low held above the 21-day line.
article.watch: Watch for the stock to hold above the buy point on any pullback; a close 7-8% below it is the standard sell rule.
